notes.title: MINING UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Descend deep below the surface and uncover a new world of power!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38067482/e18d91e16a8e9bda1a56c1e2d5a0d2a67485720f.png"] Power Up Your Items! Use ingots and materials to craft items, making them incredibly powerful. Find rare recipes and unlock their full potential.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38067482/19a08b98a90cc0e3dbc5b73dc78191c8a31f80f0.png"] Craft Items! Unlock Recipes through monster drops or purchase some recipes in the shop! Craft Recipes using resources!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38067482/710e749ba3ef42f36d25e9192a7df51a7be91398.png"] Socket Gems into Items! Craft Gems and Socket them into items to unlock your items full potential!

Descend the Mine! Go deeper and deeper into the mine, facing new challenges and discovering more valuable resources the further down you go.

Find Recipes! New item and gem recipes are found in the Crafting Coin shop or monster drops. Seek them out to create powerful new equipment and upgrades.

Mining Quests! Complete Mining Quests to unlock Crafting Coins used to purchase upgrades, recipes, and more!

Compete on the Leaderboard! Challenge other players to see who has the most powerful mine and can descend the furthest. Prove your mining mastery!

Upgrade Miners! Increase your mining efficiency by upgrading your miners. They'll help you extract resources faster and more effectively.

Unlock Mining Power! Progress through the new mining system to unlock special abilities and passive bonuses that will aid you on your journey.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38067482/33bac565e4ad662214a1a65e4cf392489b2b7a50.png"]


Updated UI


We've given the UI a fresh coat of paint to make navigating the game, especially the new mining systems, a smoother and more enjoyable experience.

notes.notes:
Updated UI Graphics, Layout, More information.
Added Help Menu - with lots of information!
Added Research Finished Tooltip
Added Items Found Tooltip
Added Leaderboard to auto appear (toggle on/off)
Fixed lots of bugs

notes.title: Patch Notes - Bug fixes, Save Auto Backup
notes.notes:
Fixed a lot of bugs.
Added a auto backup save every 4 hours.
Detection for corrupt files will automatically attempt to load the backup file.
Added Daily gems for manual save. Once every 24 hours.
More to come...
